[50cent] Absolute chemical garbage from a natural-health perspective. The primary issue is the excessive, persistent fragrance formulation, which leaves volatile aromatic compounds and detergent residues embedded in clothing, towels and bedding, creating continuous dermal contact and repeated respiratory exposure. It is also a highly alkaline powder containing aggressive anionic surfactants, with airborne particulates that can irritate the eyes, skin, nasal mucosa and respiratory tract during handling. Particularly inappropriate for anyone with eczema, asthma, contact dermatitis, fragrance sensitivity or migraine susceptibility. “Rose Fresh” is nothing more than botanical-looking marketing for an unnecessarily perfumed industrial detergent. Leave it on the shelf and buy a genuinely fragrance-free, dye-free alternative.
